name: okf-cc-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for the Open Knowledge Format (OKF).

plugins.name: okf-core
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.3 spec reference, the upstream okf-generate and okf-consume skills, and the okf-search agent.

plugins.name: okf-reader
plugins.description: Loads OKF knowledge bundles into Claude Code sessions, lazily and by declared authority.

plugins.name: okf-writer
plugins.description: Authors Open Knowledge Format (OKF) concept documents and keeps templates, indexes, and logs in sync.

plugins.name: okf-memory
plugins.description: Serves an OKF memory (structural outline with line numbers) instead of reading oversized files in full.
